findings: Marketplace leak (Day-1, confirmed 14 Sep 2026): Amazon, Flipkart, Moglix and IndiaMART already sell Microtek solar. Solar ads and PDPs do not link them. Own e-shop is UPS-first; the solar banner 404s to /product/product/enquire-now. D2C buyers compare reviews and checkout on Amazon. Sending them to a 7-field Enquire form is a trust and conversion leak. Put official Buy-on-Amazon / Buy-on-Flipkart on every solar ad and PDP. Syndicate 4-star reviews back onto microtek.in.

Wrong landing for solar spend: microtekdirect.com 301s to microtek.in. Hero carousel = Bajaj, I-Lithium UPS, lithium combo, line-interactive, next-gen home inverter. Solar is buried in the nav. Rs.20 L+/mo of 'Microtek Solar' clicks are paying for a UPS homepage. Ship /solar/ as the ad destination: hybrid vs GTI vs SMU vs panel, price, BIS/IEC, 3-field WhatsApp.

WhatsApp is service, not sales: Day-1 dest = WhatsApp. Widget 7283838383 is 'send Hi to register warranty/AMC'. Sales number is 9711666444. Enquire Now asks name, mobile, email*, pincode, state, city, category. 9pm 'hybrid vs GTI?' will not finish that. Ad CTA = Send WhatsApp Message to a *sales* line; collapse Enquire to 3 fields (pincode, phone, SKU).

Bajaj EMI excludes solar: Homepage leads with Bajaj Finance. Eligible categories on /bajaj-finance = Battery Combo / Inverter / Battery / Inverter Battery Combo. No Solar. A Rs.70k GTI or panel set is an EMI product. Add solar SKUs to Bajaj (or a solar NBFC) and put 'EMI from Rs.X' on the solar landing. Load calculator is a UPS watt tool - add a solar kW + bill widget (phone before the number).

Creative / proof: Hybrid inverter heroes are filename ChatGPT-Image-Jun-23-2026. Studio product shots, no unboxing, no roof, no net-meter. MouthShut Microtek inverter 2.95 / 5,416. Amazon solar SKUs sit at ~3.3-3.6. Claim is 15 crore customers. The ad still looks like a UPS catalogue. 10 UGC Reels (install + app + SMU retrofit) replace the ChatGPT art.

Subsidy copy is a blog, not a PDP: Jan 2026 blog explains PM Surya Ghar; GTI page only says 'government incentives'. Do not print Rs.78,000 as a Microtek discount - CFA is on the installed system via an MNRE vendor. Honest line: 'BIS/IEC GTI + panels that an empanelled installer can put in a PM Surya Ghar system. We do not approve subsidy.' About-page counters look like dummy JS (3456 patents / 6789 copyrights) - same trust leak as Fenice/Freyr zeros.
competitors: Amazon/Flipkart brand stores with review volume. Wider service (3,000-4,000+ points). Stronger ALMM/hybrid-lithium story (Jul-Aug 2026 comparisons). Solar is a first-class category, not a UPS afterthought.
You win on price (Rs.1-3k cheaper / Rs.10-15k on 3 kW). You lose on marketplace CTA and solar-first landing. Link Amazon. Make /solar/ the ad URL.
D2C solar+inverter brands with SKU ads to marketplace or 3-field forms. Lithium + app as the hook.

Solar-native brands. Efficiency and monitoring as the ad. Loom runs UGC unboxing. Growatt/Solis win the 'best inverter 2026' lists Microtek is filed under 'budget / off-grid'.
GTI 10-yr + BIS + live app is the on-grid answer. Put it on the creative. Stop leading solar ads with Home UPS.
The default checkout. 3.6 stars on Hybrid 1875 is the review the buyer will read even if your ad is beautiful.
Official brand store + review replies + 'Buy on Amazon' in the ad. Own the PDP you already pay for.
